title: Channel
lead: Channels are the primary inter-coroutine communication mechanism.

sections.heading: Declaration
sections.after_text: Name a channel with `const`. `Channel<T>` is an audited synchronization handle: its binding is stable while `send`/`recv` mutate protected runtime state.

sections.heading: Concurrency rules
bullets: The target Channel<T> payload domain requires copyable, storable, Sendable T; complete channel/go qualification remains separate from this contract
Qualified channel handles may be captured by go closures when the full type satisfies Sendable
Array payloads preserve logical copies without a required copy/move marker; class and synchronized identities are not duplicated or frozen
Noncopyable resources are outside the first Channel<T> payload domain; const or a synchronization wrapper cannot bypass Sendable checks
